summary.text: Erick Harris was elected in 2024 to represent House District 39 in the Oklahoma House of Representatives. He is an attorney and general counsel for a transportation company in Oklahoma City.

paragraphs.text: Harris earned a bachelor's degree from Tuskegee University, where he served as student body president, and a law degree and a Master's in Public Administration from the University of Oklahoma, where he was editor-in-chief of a law review.

He previously worked as an Assistant Attorney General for the Oklahoma Attorney General's Office and taught American Government at the University of Central Oklahoma for nearly 10 years as an adjunct professor.
Harris serves on the Tuskegee University board of trustees and is a member of the Muscogee (Creek) Nation of Oklahoma.
He lives in Edmond with his wife, Melissa, and their two children.
